SelectSql

The SELECT statement.

Used with the AddToWhere type and the SelectSourceTable only.

With AddToWhere, client code may add to Where.

With SelectSourceTable, client code executes the statement as the following 

select * from ({SelectSql.Text}) X where {UserWhere}
